source.evidence: Orange curly braces enclose a blue industrial rack; all elements have clear white margin.

29x29.evidence: Both braces and the three rack slots remain distinct.

30x23.evidence: Braces, rack and module divisions remain recognizable.

30x18.evidence: The two braces frame the white-slotted rack; terminal details soften.

16x16.evidence: The frame and braces survive, while the small lower terminals merge.

distinctness.evidence: The actual five designs have distinct configurations at 30x18: rack with two side sliders, rack crossed by a diagonal wrench, rack enclosed by curly braces, rack above two knobs, and gear inside rack. This is within-set review only; collection-wide comparison remains outstanding.
